**FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE**

**New York City, NY --- November 8th, 2026** --- The nation's top environmental watchdog, Green Transit Alliance (GTA) keeps track of public transit emissions using the GTA Value Index (GTA VI). Each year, the three agencies with the highest GTA VI's are awarded according to agency size: small, medium, and large.   

## Data Acquisition and Preparation

```{r}
#| output: false

#Task 1a: Data Acquisition - State Electricity Profiles
# ***Instructor's code*** #
library(tidyverse)
library(stringr)
library(httr2)
library(rvest)

get_eia_sep <- function(state, abbr){
    library(tidyverse)
    library(stringr)
    library(httr2)
    library(rvest)
    library(fs)
  
    state_formatted <- str_to_lower(state) |> str_replace_all("\\s", "")
    
    dir_name <- fs::path("data", "mp02")
    file_name <- fs::path(dir_name, state_formatted)
    
    fs::dir_create(dir_name, recurse=TRUE)
    
    if(!fs::file_exists(file_name)){
        BASE_URL <- "https://www.eia.gov"
        RESPONSE <- request(BASE_URL) |> 
          req_url_path("electricity", 
                       "state", 
                       state_formatted) |>
          req_headers(
            `User-Agent` = "Mozilla/5.0 (Macintosh; Intel Mac OS X 10.15; rv:149.0) Gecko/20100101 Firefox/149.0"
            ) |>   
          req_retry(
                max_tries = 4, 
          ) |>
          req_perform(file_name)
    
        resp_check_status(RESPONSE)
    }
    
    TABLE <- read_html(file_name) |> 
        html_element("table") |> 
        html_table() |>
        mutate(Item = str_to_lower(Item))
    
    if("U.S. rank" %in% colnames(TABLE)){
        TABLE <- TABLE |> rename(Rank = `U.S. rank`)
    }
    
    CO2_MWh <- TABLE |> 
        filter(Item == "carbon dioxide (lbs/mwh)") |>
        pull(Value) |> 
        str_replace_all(",", "") |>
        as.numeric()
    
    PRIMARY <- TABLE |> 
        filter(Item == "primary energy source") |> 
        pull(Rank)
    
    RATE <- TABLE |>
        filter(Item == "average retail price (cents/kwh)") |>
        pull(Value) |>
        as.numeric()
    
    GENERATION_MWh <- TABLE |>
        filter(Item == "net generation (megawatthours)") |>
        pull(Value) |>
        str_replace_all(",", "") |>
        as.numeric()
    
    data.frame(CO2_MWh               = CO2_MWh, 
               primary_source        = PRIMARY,
               electricity_price_MWh = RATE * 10, # / 100 cents to dollars &
               # * 1000 kWh to MWH 
               generation_MWh        = GENERATION_MWh, 
               state                 = state, 
               abbreviation          = abbr
    )
}

EIA_SEP_REPORT <- map2(state.name, state.abb, get_eia_sep) |> list_rbind()

# ***My code*** #
library(gt)
library(tidyverse)

#Format columns and apply gt styles
EIA_SEP_REPORT |> 
  mutate(
    State = paste0(state, ", (", abbreviation, ")")
  ) |> 
  select(
    `CO2 Emitted Per MWh of Electricity Produced (lbs)` = CO2_MWh,
    `Primary Source of Electricity Generation` = primary_source,
    `Average Retail Price (per MWh)` = electricity_price_MWh,
    `Total Generation Capacity (MWh)` = generation_MWh,
    State
  ) |> 
  # Turn it into a gt table object
  gt() |> 
  # Format the price column as currency ($XX.XX)
  fmt_currency(
    columns = `Average Retail Price (per MWh)`,
    decimals = 2
  ) |> 
  # Add commas per 1,000 increment for the total capacity
  fmt_integer(
    columns = `Total Generation Capacity (MWh)`,
    use_seps = TRUE
  )


```
```{r}
#| output: false

#Task 1b: Data Acquisition - NTD Energy Usage
# ***Instructor's code*** #
load_ntd_energy <- function(){
  library(readxl)
  library(httr2)
  library(tidyverse)
  library(fs)
  
  # Create 'data/mp02' directory if not already present
  DATA_DIR <- fs::path("data", "mp02")
  fs::dir_create(DATA_DIR, recurse=TRUE)

  NTD_ENERGY_FILE <- fs::path(DATA_DIR, "2025_ntd_energy.xlsx")

  if(!fs::file_exists(NTD_ENERGY_FILE)){
    library(httr2)
  
    request("https://www.transit.dot.gov/") |>
      req_url_path("sites",
                   "fta.dot.gov",
                   "files",
                   "2026-09",
                   "2025 Energy Consumption_260806.xlsx") |> 
      req_headers(
        `User-Agent` = "Mozilla/5.0 (Macintosh; Intel Mac OS X 10.15; rv:149.0) Gecko/20100101 Firefox/149.0") |> 
      req_perform(NTD_ENERGY_FILE)
  }
  
  if(file.info(NTD_ENERGY_FILE)$size < 1e4){
        cat("I was unable to download the NTD Energy File. Please try again.\n")
        stop("Download failed. Please delete the corrupted file by running `unlink('data/mp02/2025_ntd_energy.xlsx')` and try again.")
    }

  to_numeric_fill_0 <- function(x){
    x <- if_else(x == "-", NA, x)
    replace_na(as.numeric(x), 0)
  }

  read_excel(NTD_ENERGY_FILE) |> 
    select(-c(`Reporter Type`, 
              `Reporting Module`, 
              `Gallons of Other Fuel`, 
              `Other Fuel Description`)) |>
    mutate(across(-c(`Agency Name`, 
                     `Mode`,
                     `TOS`), 
                  to_numeric_fill_0)) |>
    group_by(`NTD ID`, `Mode`, `Agency Name`) |>
    summarize(across(where(is.numeric), sum), 
              .groups = "keep") |>
    mutate(ENERGY = sum(c_across(c(where(is.numeric))))) |>
    filter(ENERGY > 0) |>
    select(-ENERGY) |>
    ungroup()
}

NTD_ENERGY <- load_ntd_energy()


```
```{r}
#| output: false
#Task 1c: Data Acquisition - Transit Service Provided
# ***Instructor's code*** #
load_ntd_service <- function(){
  library(httr2)
  library(tidyverse)
  library(fs)
  
  # Create 'data/mp02' directory if not already present
  DATA_DIR <- fs::path("data", "mp02")
  fs::dir_create(DATA_DIR, recurse=TRUE)

  NTD_SERVICE_FILE <- fs::path(DATA_DIR, "2025_ntd_service.csv")

  if(!fs::file_exists(NTD_SERVICE_FILE)){
    library(httr2)
  
    request("https://data.transportation.gov/resource/4fir-qbim.csv") |>
      req_url_query(`$query`=paste(
        "SELECT  `_5_digit_ntd_id` AS `NTD_ID`", 
        "`max_agency` AS `AGENCY`",
        "`max_reporter_type` AS `reporter_type`",
        "`max_organization_type` AS `organization_type`",
        "`max_city` AS `city`",
        "`max_state` AS `state`",
        "`mode`",
        "`type_of_service`",
        "`max_primary_uza_code` as `uza_code`",
        "`max_primary_uza_name` as `uza_name`",
        "`max_primary_uza_area_sq_miles` as `uza_sq_miles`",
        "`max_primary_uza_population` as `uza_population`",
        "`max_service_area_sq_miles` as `service_area_sq_miles`",
        "`max_service_area_population` as `service_area_population`",
        "`questionable_record` as `flagged_likely_inaccurate`",
        "`sum_unlinked_passenger_trips_upt` as `total_upt`",
        "`sum_passenger_miles` WHERE caseless_one_of(`report_year`, '2025') limit 50000", 
        sep=",")) |>
      req_headers(
        `User-Agent` = "Mozilla/5.0 (Macintosh; Intel Mac OS X 10.15; rv:149.0) Gecko/20100101 Firefox/149.0") |> 
      req_perform(NTD_SERVICE_FILE)
  }
  
  if(file.info(NTD_SERVICE_FILE)$size < 1e4){
        cat("I was unable to download the NTD Service File. Please try again.\n")
        stop("Download failed. Please delete the corrupted file by running `unlink('data/mp02/2025_ntd_service.xlsx')` and try again.")
    }

  read_csv(NTD_SERVICE_FILE) |>
    mutate(flagged_likely_inaccurate = !is.na(flagged_likely_inaccurate))
}

NTD_SERVICE <- load_ntd_service()
```

## Exploratory Data Analysis 
```{r}
#Task 3a: Initial Analysis of SEP Data
#Question 1
library(tidyverse)

# 1. Filter out the top 5 most expensive states
top_5_expensive <- EIA_SEP_REPORT |> 
  slice_max(electricity_price_MWh, n = 5)

# 2. Build the bar chart
ggplot(top_5_expensive, aes(x = electricity_price_MWh, y = reorder(state, electricity_price_MWh))) +
  geom_col(fill = "darkgreen") +
  # Add labels to the ends of the bars formatted as currency
  geom_text(aes(label = scales::dollar(electricity_price_MWh)), 
            hjust = -0.1, fontface = "bold") +
  # Expand the x-axis limits slightly to ensure labels don't get cut off
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::dollar_format(), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.15))) +
  labs(
    title = "Top 5 States with the Most Expensive Electricity Prices",
    x = "Average Retail Price (per MWh)",
    y = "State"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 11)
  )
```


```{r}
#Question 2
library(tidyverse)
library(gt)

# 1. Filter top 5 states and calculate row-wide color hex codes
top_5_dirty <- EIA_SEP_REPORT |> 
  slice_max(CO2_MWh, n = 5) |> 
  mutate(
    State = paste0(state, ", (", abbreviation, ")"),
    row_color = scales::col_numeric(palette = c("#F5F5DC", "#8B4513"), domain = NULL)(CO2_MWh)
  ) |> 
  select(
    `CO2 Emitted Per MWh of Electricity Produced (lbs)` = CO2_MWh,
    `Primary Source of Electricity Generation` = primary_source,
    `Average Retail Price (per MWh)` = electricity_price_MWh,
    `Total Generation Capacity (MWh)` = generation_MWh,
    State,
    row_color
  )

# 2. Build table structure and apply text/number formatting
dirty_table <- top_5_dirty |> 
  select(-row_color) |> 
  gt() |> 
  tab_header(
    title = md("**Top 5 States with the Dirtiest Electricity Mixes**"), # Bold Title
    subtitle = md("*Ranked by highest pounds of CO2 emitted per Megawatthour (MWh)*") # Italic Subtitle
  ) |> 
  fmt_currency(columns = `Average Retail Price (per MWh)`, decimals = 2) |> 
  fmt_integer(columns = c(`Total Generation Capacity (MWh)`, `CO2 Emitted Per MWh of Electricity Produced (lbs)`), use_seps = TRUE) |> 
  
  # 3. Style Header Block (Grey background and bold labels)
  tab_style(
    style = list(
      cell_fill(color = "#EFEFEF"), # Clean light grey background
      cell_text(weight = "bold")    # Bold lettering
    ),
    locations = list(
      cells_column_labels(columns = everything()), # Bold all column labels
      cells_title(groups = "title")                # Apply to title block
    )
  )

# 4. Apply the synchronized brown colors to each body row
for(i in 1:nrow(top_5_dirty)) {
  dirty_table <- dirty_table |> 
    tab_style(
      style = cell_fill(color = top_5_dirty$row_color[i], alpha = 0.5),
      locations = cells_body(rows = i)
    )
}

# Display the styled table
dirty_table


```

```{r}
#Question 3
library(tidyverse)

# Calculate the weighted national average
us_weighted_co2 <- EIA_SEP_REPORT |> 
  summarize(
    total_emissions_lbs = sum(CO2_MWh * generation_MWh, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_generation_MWh = sum(generation_MWh, na.rm = TRUE),
    weighted_avg_lbs_MWh = total_emissions_lbs / total_generation_MWh
  ) |> 
  pull(weighted_avg_lbs_MWh)

# Print a nicely rounded answer
round(us_weighted_co2, 1)

```
On average, **`r round(us_weighted_co2, 1)`** pounds of CO2 are emitted per MWh of electricity produced in the US.
